verdict.rationale: Dover documents collecting structured feedback from every interviewer, which is one bias-reduction element of the story. Nothing shows feedback ordering or blinding (such as hiding others' feedback until submission), demographic-blind review, or DEI funnel reporting; the general conversion visibility claim is not DEI reporting. missing for 10: feedback ordering/independent submission controls, demographic-blind or anonymized review options, DEI/diversity funnel reporting, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the platform helps reduce bias — structured feedback ordering, demographic-blind review options, and DEI reporting on the funnel

citations.quote: collect structured feedback from every interviewer
